label: input u at original position 2-3, in sequences starting with z/s/f/e/b
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit that fires almost only during the original phase at t=2 or t=3 (no activity at t<=1 or t>=4 and essentially none in the copy phase). The input is u for 93% of activation mass, with d giving the rest (6%). Whether it fires on u depends heavily on the earlier tokens: a first token of z (41% of mass), s, f, e, or b raises the rate, and so does a preceding 0/w/y/j. The largest activations are prefixes like z z j u and z f 0 u. Gating u at t in {2,3} on first_tok in {z,s,f,e,b} recovers about 82% of mass, but precision is only about 27%: many such u steps stay below threshold, so the exact preceding tokens act like a graded weighted sum that a simple predicate does not capture. It does not fire on u at later positions, on other letters or digits (apart from occasional d or o), or on <DEL> and copy steps.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=s (+2.99), orig0=z (+2.93), t=2 & in_tok=u (+2.70), t=3 & in_tok=u (+2.68), prev_tok=0 (+2.53), orig0=f (+2.41). Lower it: orig1=g (-1.56), orig1=2 (-1.40), in_first=0 (-0.76), n_digits=2 (-0.62).
